items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: I played with, uh, Chink Martinet and, uh, Paul Lionel

ctx.x: To get you started. What did your cousin say? They'd have ten men and there'd be four niggers, five dummies?

Yeah. Yeah, you see. Excuse me. He used to tell me that. He would say they had folk calling people in a plane. I said, well, I turn around and look. I said, well, I surely don't see anybody around here. Look, she called it. He said, well, they got four of them in here playing. And they'd point them out to me afterwards, you know. But I was green as grass, man. I was a big time. Boy, I thought, man, playing in that band, boy, I was something big. You know, just starting out in a band like Fisher's Band. And there…
